2. Returns only one zero point (even if there are many)
3. Takes a list with even number of coefficients and largest non-zero coefficient (guarantees a solution)

The implementation uses Newton-Raphson method with:
- Initial guess: x = 0.0
- Maximum 100 iterations
- Tolerance: 1e-10
